name: VisualCV
title: visualcv.com
shortDescription: VisualCV is an online tool designed to help users create professional-looking resumes and CVs quickly and efficiently. It caters to job seekers across various industries, offering over 30+ customizable templates and AI-powered editing tools. Users can start from scratch or import existing resumes, enhancing them with industry-specific skills and designs. An ideal use case is for a job applicant in tech or marketing looking to craft a standout resume that captures attention.
pros: Wide range of templates and designs
